value.rationale: Randomized Gauss-Seidel is an exact coordinate-minimization method with classical expected convergence guarantees, while the ordinary equation residual is a common solver diagnostic. The theorem gives a complete two-dimensional fixed-matrix test and a sharp condition-number boundary showing exactly when that diagnostic is guaranteed to improve in conditional expectation. The \(\kappa=3\) witness demonstrates a genuine metric mismatch rather than a small asymptotic effect.
